business_summary: GLP J-REIT is a real estate investment corporation (J-REIT) specializing in logistics facilities, and it primarily invests in modern logistics facilities. GLP J-REIT was founded in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations with GLP Japan Advisors Inc. (hereinafter the Asset Manager) as the founder. It has its units listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange since December 21, 2012. Investing in highly functional modern logistics facilities and taking advantage of the wealth of experience and management resources with GLP Japan Inc. (Note) as the sponsor, GLP J-REIT aims to earn stable income and achieve steady growth in assets under management over the medium and long terms. Since the inception of its operation as a listed J-REIT with 30 properties (total acquisition price of 208,731 million yen) in January 2013, GLP J-REIT has been steadily expanding its assets through the continuous acquisitions of properties. As of the end of the current fiscal period, GLP J-REIT owns 85 properties (total acquisition price of 869,529 million yen). Effective March 1, 2025, GLP Japan Inc. became part of Ares Management Corporation. GLP J-REIT was established on September 16, 2011 and incorporated in Japan.
business_summary_ko: GLP J-REIT는 물류시설 전문 부동산투자회사(J-REIT)로, 현대식 물류시설에 주로 투자하고 있습니다. GLP J-REIT는 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률에 따라 GLP Japan Advisors Inc.(이하 자산운용사)를 창립자로 하여 설립되었습니다. 2012년 12월 21일부터 도쿄증권거래소 부동산투자신탁시장에 상장되어 있습니다. GLP Japan Inc.(주)를 스폰서로 하여 기능성이 뛰어난 현대식 물류시설에 투자하고 풍부한 경험과 경영자원을 활용하는 GLP J-REIT는 중장기적으로 안정적인 수익 창출과 운용자산의 꾸준한 성장을 목표로 하고 있습니다. GLP J-REIT는 2013년 1월 30개 부동산(총취득금액 208,731백만 엔)을 보유한 상장 J-REIT로 운영을 시작한 이후 지속적인 부동산 취득을 통해 꾸준히 자산을 확대해 왔습니다. 금 회계연도 말 현재 GLP J-REIT는 85개 부동산(총 취득 가격 869,529백만엔)을 보유하고 있습니다. 2025년 3월 1일부터 GLP Japan Inc.는 Ares Management Corporation의 일부가 되었습니다.
